en.meta.title: AIO LCD screen: temps, FPS and GIFs on your pump, free
en.meta.desc: Show temperatures, FPS, the song, a clock or your own GIF on the screen of a CORSAIR iCUE LINK or NZXT Kraken pump. An iCUE LINK screen works with iCUE closed.
en.ld.q1: Do I need iCUE for a CORSAIR pump screen?
en.ld.a1: Not for the iCUE LINK AIO LCD: with iCUE closed, Xenon draws on it straight over USB, on Windows and as Beta on Linux. With iCUE open, Xenon's pump widget in iCUE does the same.
en.ld.a2: Yes. The pump screen, the Xenon and Gauge styles and your own pictures are free, with no account.
en.ld.q3: Does it work on Mac or Linux?
en.ld.a3: The iCUE LINK AIO LCD works on Linux as Beta, with OpenLinkHub closed. The other pumps need Windows, and there is no pump screen on a Mac.
en.aio.h1: Your AIO pump's screen, run by Xenon
en.aio.lede: The round or square screen on a CORSAIR iCUE LINK or NZXT Kraken pump can show what Xenon shows and change by itself: your temperatures and FPS while you play, the song while you listen to music, a clock or your own picture the rest of the time, and alerts as they arrive.
en.aio.pic.alt: Xenon, Screens, with the pump picked: a round face with the CPU at 61 °C and the GPU at 72 °C, PC readings on the pump now, the tabs What it shows, Alerts, Lights and Look, and the lines When you play and When you listen to music.
en.aio.shows.p1: Open Xenon → Screens and tap the pump. What it shows has one line for each moment: when you play, when you listen to music, the rest of the time. When two apply at once, the higher line wins, and the menu says what is on the pump now and why.
en.aio.shows.p2: Add puts in more moments: when you are live, when you record, at night, when the PC is busy or idle, at certain hours. Each face shows up to four PC readings: temperatures, load, RAM, VRAM, power, FPS and clocks.
en.aio.shows.p3: Alerts chooses what comes over the face and for how long: notifications, calls, a finished timer, Discord messages, a PC running too hot. It can leave out the message text. Five examples (Gamer, Music, Animated, Clock hands, Monitor) fill every line in one tap.
en.aio.h.styles: Xenon, Gauge or a style of your own
en.aio.styles.p1: Xenon, the free default, draws each face on a soft drop of colour that turns amber or red with the hottest reading and moves faster the harder the PC works. Gauge draws an instrument: a dial with a needle, the song's minutes on a dial, a clock with hands, the date and the weather.
en.aio.styles.p2: A Store widget made for pump screens can be one face or the whole style. You can also make one in Xenon Maker, or ask Bit: "make the pump screen look like a car dashboard".
en.aio.styles.p3: Each line has its own look: Live colours that follow how hard each part works, your theme, colours from the picture or any colour, bigger numbers, °C or °F, and a few words of your own.
en.aio.gif.p1: Use your own picture or GIF puts a PNG, JPG, WebP, GIF or WebM of up to 20 MB on the pump. Look turns the screen, sets its brightness and darkens it at night. A settings backup keeps your pictures.
en.aio.lights.p1: On a CORSAIR pump, the ring of LEDs around the screen can follow what it shows: the colours of your GIF, picture or the song's cover, the theme colour, two colours of your own, or stay dark. Same colours across the PC paints the fans, keyboard and other lights in the same colours.
en.aio.lights.p2: Its effects come in four groups: calm, moving, music, and your PC, where the ring fills up to a reading, warms with the heat, shows the clock, turns with your fans' real speed or follows today's sky and the weather.
en.aio.pump.r0c1: Straight over USB with iCUE closed, up to 20 pictures a second. When iCUE opens, Xenon steps aside and never closes it
en.aio.pump.r1c0: A CORSAIR pump screen in iCUE
en.aio.pump.r1c1: Xenon's pump widget, added in iCUE and picked for the pump's screen
en.aio.pump.r2c1: Paste the address Xenon shows into NZXT CAM
en.aio.pumps.p1: When Xenon closes, the pump goes back to its own picture. Bit, Deck keys and a paired phone can change what it shows too, for example "show the clock on the pump".
en.aio.faq.icue.q: Do I need iCUE for a CORSAIR pump screen?
en.aio.faq.icue.a: Not for the iCUE LINK AIO LCD: with iCUE closed, Xenon draws on it straight over USB, on Windows and as Beta on Linux. With iCUE open, Xenon's pump widget in iCUE does the same.
en.aio.faq.free.a: Yes. The pump screen, the Xenon and Gauge styles and your own pictures are free, with no account.
en.aio.faq.mac.q: Does it work on Mac or Linux?
en.aio.faq.mac.a: The iCUE LINK AIO LCD works on Linux as Beta, with OpenLinkHub closed. The other pumps need Windows, and there is no pump screen on a Mac.
en.aio.cta.p: Free, with no account. Download Xenon for Windows, or pick your system on the download page. To let Xenon drive the pump and the fans too, read Fan control without fan curves.
